web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July from 50.3 in June, indicating a contraction in factory activity. This decline was unexpected and below economists' forecast of 50.0, marking the weakest level since February. The sub-index for new orders dropped to 48.5, the lowest since 2023, while the production sub-index fell to 49.9. The disappointing data suggests a demand slump and could heighten expectations for economic easing.
